Since a decision node with two branches, followed by process/terminal chains, is exactly what `flowchart` (not `table`) is for — the ROLES here are steps and a binary decision, not attribute combinations — I used the `flowchart` genre at the `0.1` floor (no `statechart`/`sequence` features needed).

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
errorsfound -> escalate "no"
clearcounters -> monitor
```

Embed once built:

```markdown
![BGP session reset procedure flowchart](figures/bgp-session-reset.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/bgp-session-reset.fd](figures/bgp-session-reset.fd)</sub>
```
